root.label: US begins sending migrants to Guantanamo detention center

events.label: US begins sending migrants to Guantanamo detention center

slots.name: detainees held
slots.sentence: At times, the facilities held close to 200 detainees, many of whom were deported to Honduras, Venezuela or other countries.

slots.name: other facilities capacity
slots.sentence: According to a U.S. defense official, who spoke to VOA on the condition of anonymity, the prison as currently configured can hold only 130 detainees, while the base's Migrant Operations Center and a temporary tent city can hold, at most, 550 people.

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: FILE - Newly erected holding tents for detained migrants are seen at the United States' Naval Station Guantanamo Bay in Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, Feb. 21, 2025. (U.S. Navy/AFN Guantanamo Bay Public Affairs/Handout via Reuters)
